HR Services

Human Resources

Room: 208, Floor: 2, Building: 1, BUBT Main Campus

About the Office

The Human Resources Office at BUBT manages recruitment, staff development, and employee welfare. It oversees performance management, training, and compliance with university policies to ensure a motivated, skilled, and efficient workforce that supports the institution’s academic and administrative goals.
3000+
Students Served
15
Processing Time
13
Staff Members
95%
Accuracy Rate

Services of Our Office

Recruitment & Staffing

Faculty and staff recruitment and selection Appointment, promotion, and confirmation processes Manpower planning and workforce management

Employee Records & Administration

Maintenance of faculty and staff records Service books, personal files, and documentation Issuance of HR-related certificates and letters

Compensation & Benefits

Salary structure, payroll coordination, and allowances Leave management and attendance policies Benefits administration in accordance with university rules

Performance Management

Performance evaluation and appraisal support Promotion and increment process coordination Monitoring of service quality and compliance

Training & Professional Development

Faculty and staff training programs Workshops, seminars, and capacity-building initiatives Support for career development and skill enhancement

Employee Relations & Welfare

Employee engagement and welfare initiatives Conflict resolution and counseling support Health, safety, and workplace well-being
